Table 1: Students' response to major factors affecting they're practicing fluency in English speaking at home.
No. Questions Variables Number of responses Proportion
What are the major problems affecting your English speaking practice at home? Lack of partner 11 36.66 %
Lack of time Lack of 8 26.66 %
excellent study environment 11 36.66 %
Total 30 100%
It is firmly noticeable that having a lack of a partner to practice speaking and having a lack of an excellent study environment were the main problems which students encountered when they studied at home, followed by 11 (36.66%) and 11 (36.66%). Besides that, the figure for having a lack of time for practicing speaking at home was just approximately 27%. This represented having a lack of partners & excellent study environment were key factors affecting the ability of oral fluency in English speaking of AV113 students. Table 2: Students respond to how often they practice speaking skills by following methods such as reading books, watching movies, and writing paragraphs.
No. Questions Variables Number of responses Proportion
How often do you practice speaking skills by following methods such as reading books, watching movies, and writing paragraphs? Always 12 8 40 %
Sometimes 8 26.66 %
Never 10 33.33 %
Total 30 100%
As the information depicted in the above table, 12 (40%) and 10 (33.33%) students always answered and never, respectively. Plus, eight students who spent lack of time for those activities was just around 26.66%. Indeed, these figures led to the imbalance between helpful activities for English speaking practice, and it also wreaked havoc on the student's oral fluency improvement.
